title: Final position coordinates
description: Essential Criteria: The response must state the final position as (0.40 m, 0.20 m).

title: Acceleration calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the constant acceleration magnitude as a = qE/m = 0.20 m/s².

title: First-second kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the x-velocity (0.20 m/s) and x-displacement (0.10 m) after the first 1.0 s interval.

title: Second-second kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly determine the position (0.30 m, 0.10 m) and y-velocity (0.20 m/s) at the end of the second 1.0 s interval.

title: Third-second deceleration
description: Important Criteria: The student must recognize that the third field provides accelerations opposite to the x and y velocities to bring the sphere to rest in 1.0 s.

title: Vector component handling
description: Important Criteria: The student must treat x and y motions independently and correctly add displacement vectors.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should maintain consistent SI units (meters, seconds, m/s²) throughout the solution.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize incorrect sign for acceleration components in the third interval (should oppose velocity).

title: Constant velocity assumption
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize treating motion during the second interval as accelerated in the x-direction.
